System SET UP

Display IO style, angle unit, number format, fractions, STAT FREQ column, decimal separator, contrast.

keys
SHIFT→MODE

Open with SHIFT MODE (SETUP). Scroll pages with the cursor. Defaults commonly favour MthIO MathO, Deg, Norm 2, d/c, STAT FREQ OFF, and Dot.

AreaOptionsTypical default
DisplayMthIO MathO / MthIO LineO / LineIOMthIO MathO
AngleDeg / Rad / GraDeg
DigitsFix / Sci / Norm 1 / Norm 2Norm 2
Fractionsab/c / d/cd/c
STATFREQ ON / OFFOFF
DispDot / CommaDot
OtherCONT contrast; CLR All reset—
  • MthIO MathO: textbook input and textbook exact output.
  • MthIO LineO: textbook input, linear decimal-style results.
  • LineIO: classic single-line entry (e.g. 1┘3).
  • Norm 1 uses a wider small-value exponential threshold than Norm 2.
  • Contrast: SETUP → CONT; full reset: SHIFT 9 (CLR) → All.
